text:
Maria: heads-up — ran the long-context KV cache bench suite tonight and seeing steady memory growth after ~1.2M tokens. dropping results here.

Maria: command: `./bench_kv --suite long-context --iters 200 --model gptx-30b`

Maria: quick snippet from logs:
```
iter 0 mem_rss=12.1GB kv_alloc=9.8GB
iter 50 mem_rss=13.4GB kv_alloc=11.2GB
iter 150 mem_rss=16.8GB kv_alloc=14.5GB
```

Maria: looks like kv_alloc keeps growing even when sequence reuse should evict pages.

Dan: hmm can you paste the config? eviction policy + page_size?

Maria: policy=LRU, page_size=1MB, max_pages=8192, reuse_threshold=0.8

Vikram: could be fragmentation — small prefix reuse causes many partial pages kept. did you run with `--compact-pages`?

Maria: not in this run. will rerun with compacting.

Ben: also check kernel selection path — if quantized kernels trigger different KV layout we saw similar before. which kernel: fp16-optimized?

Maria: kernels=triton-fused-attn, quant=INT4

Jess: filing a perf regression ticket? assign to eng-runtime. include reproducer + perf profile (heap/kv histograms).

Maria: created https://redwoodinc.atlassian.net/browse/RI-5821 with raw logs + bench script. added baseline from 1715120000.

ops-bot: deploy bot: Canary pool has 2 nodes running build r2026.1 — no correlated alerts.

Dan: quick idea — try `--page-ttl 30s` and measure; if eviction not honored we have bug. Also grab `/proc/meminfo` and `pmap` outputs.

Maria: re-run queued with `--compact-pages --page-ttl 30s` and `--profiling=kv-alloc,hist` — will post results in ~45m

Vikram: thanks. if it reproduces, we should add regression test under perf/kv/long-context and CI job with synthetic workload every PR.

Maria: agreed. will add smoke test (100 iters) + full nightly (2000 iters).

Ben: note: keep it short in PRs — tests should be flakiness tolerant (assert mem growth < 2% over 200 iters).

Maria: posted updated results:
```
iter 0 mem_rss=12.0GB kv_alloc=9.7GB
iter 200 mem_rss=12.5GB kv_alloc=10.2GB
```

Maria: compacting + ttl fixed steady growth down to acceptable.

Jess: awesome — please attach perf graphs and add a regression alert if nightly deviates >5%.

Maria: will do. locking ticket and starting PR for test harness.

ci-bot: CI triggered for branch kv/kv-ttl-test — 1 job queued.

Dan: thanks team, keep this thread updated with PR link.
